pairs.evidence: scripts/data-analysis/kg-compute.ts:375 With --reset --supersede, clearKg() commits its own archive-and-delete transaction, and the replacement upserts run afterwards as separate operations. A crash or failed upsert in between leaves an empty serving graph, because the replacement is neither staged nor transactional.

techniques.evidence: scripts/data-analysis/kg-compute.ts:375 Most of the guard is right: guardKgReset compares store-derived kind/rel counts and orphaned ids, refuses by default, has an explicit ugly --supersede override, names the safe upsert path, and clearKg archives to history. Missing: a staged or transactional replacement, and any report of what stays unchecked (edges inside rebuilt rels, properties on retained nodes) before it issues a blanket 'drop nothing' verdict.

scripts/data-analysis/kg-contribution-recompute.ts:282 kg-compute.ts:245 imports mergeComputedNodeProps, but kg-contribution-recompute re-spells the read-merge inline, which the technique's one-named-helper rule forbids.

scripts/data-analysis/kg-promote.ts:152 Promoted rows carry method, computedAt and a makeProvenance stamp (source, pass, ref, writer). The gate is re-run against the live graph, and non-resident edge endpoints are dropped and reported.
scripts/data-analysis/kg-promote.ts:109 The refusal set is derived as the closed enum minus the kinds this writer owns, so a new kind is protected the day it is added.

pairs.subject: civic-knowledge-graphs
pairs.evidence: features/graph/trailPath.ts:343 Enumeration stops at 64 equal-cost paths in DFS neighbour order and the tie-break ranks only that subset. On a hub-heavy query the returned 'best' path is not guaranteed to have the fewest unverified hops, yet the result is presented as the printed rule's winner.

techniques.evidence: features/graph/trailPath.ts:343 co_votes_with is excluded, hubs are priced on traversable degree with endpoints exempt, rejected edges are excluded and counted, the rule is versioned, and the tie-break is deterministic. Two gaps: capped ranking runs over a subset with no disclosure; and buildAdjacency (trailPath.ts:233) merges duplicate keys by taking the best gate and the max weight independently, which is the forbidden verified-status-plus-larger-unverified-amount combination. That merge is latent today because kg_edge's primary key is (src, rel, dst).

features/graph/forensicView.ts:65 An admit-list filter that preserves order. Hidden pending and rejected are counted separately, requested lens edges are kept and counted, and hoverCardModel counts from the unfiltered list with a deterministic sort and a 'more' count when truncated.
features/graph/catalogParity.test.ts:13 Label catalogs and pure-module mirrors are tested against the single enum. The edgeKey single-definition is also pinned by oneDefinition.test.ts.
features/graph/graphLoader.ts:284 Every canvas edge carries its gate status and verbatim provenance (pass, method, ref) through one shared helper.
